verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical: both are close to a uniform scale-down of the square onto the 300x250 canvas, not a real rearrangement. In both, the 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' attribution, the bottom-left logo and the 'SOLSTICE' can label shrink to a few pixels and can't be read. The can also sits too close to the bottom edge, and the left-column quote leaves a dead band under the attribution.
